scope: All 231 public items (easy 48, standard 72, hard 111). The site scores 534; 303 are held out or imported and not redistributed, so the judge tier (146) and the held-out halves are absent here.

server_metadata.precision: BF16 merged LoRA, FP32 pointer head
server_metadata.execution: eager, sdpa, optimized causal_conv1d, FLA_USE_COMPILE=0, cudnn sdp off
server_metadata.batcher: v12: v9 + single-request rows run as one forward, cross-request marginal-cost overhead 256 padded tokens, atomic enqueue per request, GPU work off the event loop, calibrated cost-model routing between independent rows and the shared-context path

routing.rule: shared if 2*fixed + computed tokens*slope + fork(n, prefix) < fixed + independent padded tokens*slope; floors: >=3 questions, >=64-token state

intelligence.note: Tier weights hard .30 / standard .28 / easy .14 renormalised over the tiers we can run; the judge tier (146 items, weight .28) has no public items.

ours.latency_note: Latency is not comparable: another agent shares this server, and the site measures serially from a Hetzner box; only answers are used.
